text: Mr. Mackey Jr. is a fictional character in the adult animated television series South Park, voiced by series co-creator Trey Parker and debuting in the season one episode "Mr. Hankey, the Christmas Poo." He serves as the school counselor at South Park Elementary and occasionally teaches classes there. Known for ending or beginning most of his sentences with "m'kay," he is based on Parker's junior high school counselor Stan Lackey. Mackey has a disproportionately large head due to the tightness of his tie, wears a green long-sleeved shirt, a blue tie, dark blue pants, blue leather shoes, and black-rimmed glasses, and speaks with a Southern accent. He has black yet thinning hair. According to "Insheeption," Mackey was most likely born in 1965, placing him in Generation X, a conclusion supported by references to the 1980s in episodes like "Back to the Cold War" (e.g., his childhood bedroom, the WarGames parody, and dancing to Wang Chung's "Dance Hall Days" during a duck and cover drill) and "Taming Strange" (where 1980s songs like Lionel Richie's "All Night Long (All Night)" and Glenn Frey's "The Heat Is On" play from his computer). Mackey taught sex education with Ms. Choksondik, with whom he had a sexual relationship until her death, after which he took over the fourth-grade class until Mr. Garrison returned. In "Ike's Wee Wee," he taught Mr. Garrison's class about drugs, smoking, and alcohol, but was fired after marijuana he distributed to students was stolen by Mr. Garrison, leading to his eviction by his landlord and subsequent depression and drug use. He holds generally left-wing political views, as seen in his protest against the Iraq War in the season seven episode "I'm a Little Bit Country," but in season twelve's "About Last Night," he is shown supporting John McCain's 2008 presidential campaign and expressing disappointment upon his loss, and he signs up for I.C.E. in "Got a Nut." It was presumed in "Proper Condom Use" that his last sexual encounter was 21 years prior, when he was 19. In "Something You Can Do with Your Finger" and "Cat Orgy," it is hinted that bondage sex scenes occurred between Mackey and Liane Cartman, with the former featuring Eric Cartman watching a tape of Mackey and Liane, where the latter drinks from a cup of her own urine, and the latter showing Mackey flirting with Liane. In "Insheeption," it is revealed that Mackey is a hoarder due to a troubled childhood as a fourth-grader in 1974, when he was bullied and a fan of Woodsy Owl, and after the owl molested him during a field trip, he threatened to rape Stan Marsh in the mouth if Stan threw any clutter from his office. In "Trapped in the Closet," Mackey is shown as a member of the Church of Scientology, though this is not mentioned again later. He is fluent in Spanish, as demonstrated in "Rainforest Shmainforest." Unlike many major adult characters, his first name remains unknown.
